.kbc-lineTable-button-park-success-flash-slow {
  -webkit-animation: kbc-general-button-success-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
  -moz-animation: kbc-general-button-success-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
  animation: kbc-general-button-success-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
}

.kbc-toggleHoldCall-button-danger-flash {
  -webkit-animation: kbc-general-button-danger-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
  -moz-animation: kbc-general-button-danger-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
  animation: kbc-general-button-danger-flash-keyframes 3s infinite;
}

.brOC .menuIcon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  z-index: 15;
}
